note: One Discord mirror toggle of the RAW JSON pane, instantiated once per mirrorable kind into MirrorStrip. THE KIND NAMES ARE NOT HERE and must never be: they come from the mods that registered the kinds (OZ_MirrorOps.List), so the core neither names another mod's kind nor caps how many there may be. The script writes the caption -- '<KIND>: ON', '<KIND>: OFF', 'PRESS AGAIN' -- into MirrorRowBtnText, lays the rows along the strip and shrinks them when they no longer fit; the name MirrorRowBtnText is a contract with OZ_VppMenu.c. A button ROOT holds page content instead of the Edge/Bg/Text idiom a nested button gets, so the three children are written out here -- with the names that idiom would have given them, which is what ShrinkTab walks.

panel.name: MirrorRowBtnEdge
panel.note: One unit outside the button on every side: 180x30 plus two.

label.name: MirrorRowBtnText
label.note: Empty: the caption is the kind and its state, written by PaintMirror.
